attempts.notes: Teal 2's camera is the Teledyne FLIR Hadron 640R dual EO/IR module (Boson 640 thermal core plus a 64MP-class visible sensor); a third-party integration doc shows the visible imager driven as an OmniVision OV64B (OV64B40). No opened source stated where the Boson microbolometer or the OmniVision sensor is fabricated, so no Tier 2 entry is given; note Red Cat's page lists the EO sensor as 16 MP while FLIR's datasheet specifies 64MP.
